This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.209 of the raw projection. It counts toward Volleyball scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections (it's how teams with no standings on the routes build a record of their own).

Across 657 graded Volleyball games the algo now scales scoring ×0.964 and gives home teams +0.2 sets. Team corrections so far: Tigers attack ×0.975, defense ×1.040 (5 games); Rattlers attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total outside its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
